bio.statement: The county board page says Savas was elected to the Clackamas County Commission in November 2010.
bio.excerpt: Paul Savas was elected to the Clackamas County Commission in November 2010.

bio.statement: Savas's pamphlet statement lists 25 years as a small business owner and work as an aerospace machinist.
bio.excerpt: Small Business Owner 25 years; Aerospace Machinist

bio.statement: Savas's pamphlet statement lists prior service as Oak Lodge Sanitary director and Oak Lodge Water commissioner.
bio.excerpt: Clackamas County Commissioner; Oak Lodge Sanitary Director; Oak Lodge Water Commissioner

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Savas says he passed a moratorium on data centers to protect farmland, water and neighborhoods.
positions.excerpt: Passed a moratorium on data centers to protect farmland, water, and neighborhoods.

positions.statement: Savas's pamphlet statement says he is holding the line on the budget, expanding essential services without raising taxes.
positions.excerpt: Holding the line on the budget – expanding essential services without raising taxes.

positions.statement: Savas's pamphlet statement says he led a coalition against ODOT's tolling plan on I-205.
positions.excerpt: Led a coalition against ODOT’s unfair tolling plan on I-205.

positions.statement: Savas's pamphlet statement says the county is on track to deliver 968 new affordable housing units.
positions.excerpt: On track to deliver 968 new affordable housing units.

positions.statement: Savas's pamphlet statement cites construction of a recovery campus to treat addictions and provide mental health services.
positions.excerpt: Constructing a Recovery Campus to treat addictions and provide mental health services.

positions.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Savas says the simple answer to keeping county costs down is to avoid any tax increases.
positions.excerpt: The simple answer is to avoid any tax increases.

verification.note: Added May 2026 primary context. The answers are the candidate's own: OPB's 2026-05-05 article links this PDF as "the candidates' complete answers to OPB's questions" for the May 19, 2026 primary. The PDF itself is undated, so published_at reflects the article date. Excerpt verified verbatim.

positions.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Savas says the county has a long history of fully funding the sheriff's office's budgeted expenditures and will continue to do so.
positions.excerpt: That said, we have a long history of fully funding CCSO’s budgeted expenditures and will continue to do so.

verification_summary.balance_notes: Commissioner Pos 2: Savas and Shull have 10 items each. Shull has 4 OPB questionnaire items to Savas's 2, while Savas has 5 pamphlet positions plus a county bio page. Neither file uses a campaign site (Savas's electpaulsavas.com is printed in the pamphlet and has no items). Balanced.
